test_title: PYST 9: SSC JE EE- General Intelligence (Held On 11 Oct 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some doctors are scientists.

Some scientists are engineers.

**Conclusions:**

I. All engineers are doctors.

II. Some doctors are engineers.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Statements:

Some doctors are scientists.

Some scientists are engineers.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4452d201443147b620fb9c000098800d981fc4758b51168cdceb6d81ff98fdb.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All engineers are doctors. → **Not follow** (There is no direct relation between doctors and engineers so it can be possible but not definitely true)

II. Some doctors are engineers. → **Not follow** (There is no direct relation between doctors and engineers so it can be possible but not definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor II follows".**
